title: SmolTalk-360M
synopsis: A 360M-parameter instruction-tuned language model released with open weights and a training recipe, trained on 40B tokens of filtered web and synthetic dialogue.

title: SmolTalk-7B
synopsis: A 7B-parameter instruction-tuned language model released with open weights and a training recipe, trained on 40B tokens of filtered web and synthetic dialogue.

title: I ran a 270M model on an ESP32 and it answers questions about my greenhouse
synopsis: A write-up of quantising a 270M-parameter model to 4 bits and running it on an ESP32-S3 with 8MB of PSRAM, getting roughly two tokens per second, with the sensor-query prompts that worked and the ones that did not.

title: I ran a 13B model on a workstation GPU and it answers questions about my greenhouse
synopsis: A write-up of quantising a 13B-parameter model to 4 bits and running it on a workstation GPU, getting roughly twenty tokens per second, with the sensor-query prompts that worked and the ones that did not.

title: Pretraining a 500M model to GPT-2-XL quality on a single 4090 in nine days
synopsis: The authors pretrain a 500M-parameter transformer on one consumer GPU in nine days, matching GPT-2-XL on standard benchmarks, and release the data pipeline, code, and checkpoints.

title: Pretraining a 50B model to GPT-4 quality on a 512-GPU cluster in nine days
synopsis: The authors pretrain a 50B-parameter transformer on a 512-GPU cluster in nine days, matching GPT-4 on standard benchmarks, and release the data pipeline, code, and checkpoints.

title: tinygrad-lm/rp2040-llm
synopsis: Runs a 15M-parameter character-level language model on an RP2040 microcontroller in 264KB of RAM, with the quantisation script and the flashing instructions.

title: bartowski/SmolTalk-360M-GGUF
synopsis: GGUF quantisations of SmolTalk-360M in Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M, and Q8_0.

title: nanoformer/tiny-mini-micro-lm
synopsis: A compact and efficient language model for fast inference.

title: Qwen3-1.7B released with open weights
synopsis: A 1.7B-parameter language model released with open weights, benchmarks, and a chat template.

title: Edge-AI startup raises $80M to put sub-1B models on every phone
synopsis: The company announced a Series B led by a growth fund, and says its sub-billion-parameter models will ship on handsets next year.

title: A 200M model that plays checkers by self-play, with the engine and the endgame database
synopsis: A 200M-parameter network trained by self-play reaches expert strength at checkers on one GPU in a week; the engine, the weights, and the generated endgame database are released.
